title: Complete dynamic target-direct 2026-08-09 Grade-R candidate orchestration

proposal_scope.title: Complete dynamic target-direct 2026-08-09 Grade-R candidate orchestration
proposal_scope.hypothesis: A date-aware Grade-R runner can consume the hash-bound EXP027 authority manifest and the fixed 2026-08-09 TARGET DR/DU card, reconstruct the existing 24 previous-race inputs, and run the unchanged EXP023 model, C0 calibrator, confidence threshold, candidate policy, and tie-break for all 36 races without an HTML export.
proposal_scope.null_hypothesis: The runner remains coupled to HTML or a fixed date, any of the 495 runners cannot be mapped under the audited authority contract, any race lacks a terminal record, or any model, feature, threshold, market, BUY, order, dashboard, or notification change is required.
proposal_scope.racing_mechanism: The prediction logic is unchanged; only the source adapter for the same prior-race variables changes. TARGET DR/DU fixes tomorrow's race and runner universe, while JRA-VAN SU/SR contains pre-race runner and race records needed to reconstruct the existing time, popularity, field, surface, distance, going, final-section, PCI-family, bodyweight, jockey, and track fields.
proposal_scope.target_population: All 36 fixed races and 495 runners on the 2026-08-09 Sapporo, Niigata, and Chukyo cards. Every race remains in the denominator. Chukyo 9R is an unsupported obstacle race and must be deterministic no-bet.
stop_conditions: Any additional predictive, market, threshold, or production change is required
Any direct-history authority row fails or a source contract would need weakening
Any late race would need backfill or a cutoff would need weakening
Any result, market, credential, notification, dashboard mutation, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order-capable path is encountered
The exact synthetic runner test command fails
The fixed real-data command exits before all 36 targets reach deterministic terminal records
rejection_gate: Any EXP027 manifest hash, DR hash, DU hash, config hash, target manifest hash, bundle hash, or model hash changes
Any current result, odds, popularity, market, payout, ROI, dashboard, notification, credential, BUY, stake, or order side effect reaches candidate generation
Any mapped history row violates the strict target-date cutoff
Any model, feature set, calibrator, candidate policy, confidence threshold, value policy, or tie-break changes
Any of the 24 required previous-race columns is absent
Any of the 495 runners is absent, duplicated, or mapped to a different target identity
Any output filename or candidate table lookup remains hard-coded to 2026-08-08
Any probability contract violation is accepted
Any registered target disappears or any obstacle or source-contract-failed race becomes candidate-ready
Any runner code remains dependent on an HTML source for target-direct mode
out_of_scope: Any alternative pair, ticket type, race, or stake search after observing a quote
Any dashboard mutation, notification, credential, purchase adapter, TARGET GUI automation, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order transmission
Any historical backtest, outer OOS comparison, ROI calculation, or action-policy optimization
Any model training, refit, feature addition, feature removal, calibrator change, candidate reranking, confidence threshold change, value threshold search, or tie-break change
Any odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, result, or derivative in candidate generation, confidence, ranking, tie-break, or abstention
Any silent fallback from an unprovable local or foreign latest race to an older JRA race
Any support for obstacle prediction or domains outside flat turf and flat dirt
lineage_hash_requirements: Each experienced runner maps exactly one latest provable prior row strictly before target date; an unprovable latest local or foreign race fails closed rather than selecting an older JRA row
Every Top3-set and derived WIDE distribution passes mass, finite, range, support, and duplicate checks
Every direct field records source file, source record identity, source race date, and canonical record hash
Every output sets candidate_uses_odds false, formal_buy false, send_order false, and stake zero

The approved EXP027 manifest, every referenced SU/SR file, tomorrow DR and DU, the three target manifests, fold manifest, inference bundle, feature schema, model artifact, and runner code remain hash-bound

proposal_scope.data_as_of: EXP027 completed the approved read-only 2026-08-09 authority inventory: 495/495 unique runners, 447 accepted latest JRA histories, 48 confirmed no-prior-race runners, zero contract failures, zero future-date rows, and 116/116 verified SU/SR source hashes. EXP026 then failed closed during preparation because the existing card runner was still hard-coded to HTML input and 2026-08-08 output names; no real-data inference or candidate generation ran.

chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed next-day Grade-R engineering card after synthetic-only runner preparation and a distinct run approval; there is no fitting, backtest, ROI, threshold, or policy search.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only the EXP027 authoritative newest history row with event date strictly before 2026-08-09 may populate previous-race features.
chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A target whose original cutoff passes before persistence remains in the denominator as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real DR, DU, SU, SR, historical CSV, inference, candidate, quote, result, payout, or ROI command may run during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE; only explicitly named synthetic fixture tests are allowed.

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No history row dated 2026-08-09 or later may enter target features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 tomorrow race identities and 495 runners are fixed independently of market and results.

primary_metric.name: target_direct_terminal_candidate_completeness
primary_metric.baseline: EXP027 proves complete latest-history authority, but the existing card runner cannot consume target-direct input or a non-2026-08-08 target date.
primary_metric.evaluation: All synthetic runner tests pass; the approved run maps exactly 447 histories and 48 confirmed no-history runners into all 495 rows; all 36 races reach exactly one terminal candidate or fail-closed record; all probability and safety contracts pass.

notes: Fail-closed successor to EXP026; expands the approved preparation surface only to the date-aware target-direct card runner and identity-only EXP028 config/manifests.
